content.text: {"site_name":"Halvorsen Records Annex","history":"A records annex where clerks filed paperwork nobody requested. One winter the intercom began reading the files aloud. Staff answered back. Then they stopped answering anything. The lights still cycle on schedule. Something still listens for the next shift.","memo":"Team, the Company values every one of you equally, which is why your insurance is pooled. Please return together. Paperwork for missing contractors is extensive and the toner budget is frozen.","requests":["Bring the whole crew home breathing. Headcount at the van must match headcount at the door.","Extract more than 400 in salvage value. The Company considers anything less a team-building exercise."],"notes":[{"title":"Scrawl on Breakroom Wall","body":"Written low, near the floor, in a careful hand: {{CODE_A}}. Underneath, smaller: do not say it out loud. It repeats things."},{"title":"Crumpled Supply Receipt","body":"One box of pens, one lock code: {{CODE_B}}. Delivered to {{ROOM_1}}. Signed for by nobody. The signature line hums faintly when held near your ear."}]}
